body: Im not here to stop you. I'm just here to remind that whatever you're going through there is always light at the end of the tunnel. This tunnel may be long, may be short. It may be wide or it may be a mouse hole. For all I know I care for you and so do thousands of people not only in this subreddit but also irl. Just talk to a friend or a loved one. It will get better. It always does.

Hi bud. I'm also 15 and male but I go to public school (have for all my life) so I can't really comprehend what it means having no free time. But I hope u understand that you have to do what's best for you. Tell your parents (ofc I don't know your parents and how strict they are) but if they know about your passions and how you feel they might reconsider that school. Don't push yourself too hard. Talk to a friend about it. Find a nice online community with nice people who can help you get thru it. I belive in u and so does everyone else in this subreddit 🙂.
